quote: We're beginning the Gemini 3 era by releasing Gemini 3 Pro in preview and making it available today across a suite of Google products
note: Lab (Google, with Google DeepMind) and kind (shipped model) confirmed. The date comes from the post's dateline, "Nov 18, 2025"; the quote is from the same page. A second lab post, the Google Workspace Updates item, is dated November 18, 2025 and says "Starting today, you can try our first model of the series, Gemini 3 Pro": https://workspaceupdates.googleblog.com/2025/11/introducing-gemini-3-pro-for-gemini-app.html . Wikipedia's Gemini 3 (AI) article says "On November 18, 2025, Google launched Gemini 3 Pro." and describes no staged preview before general availability. The word "preview" in the launch post and developer naming ("Gemini 3 Pro Preview") refers to the label on the day of launch, not a limited preview before public release, so preview_date is null. DataLearner lists 2026-02-01; this conflicts with the lab post and Wikipedia and was disregarded. Gemini 3 Deep Think, a separate reasoning mode, rolled out later and is not dated here.
